_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gold-miner signals with Newmont's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Newmont is the world’s leading gold company and is the only gold company included in the S&P 500 Index and the Fortune 500 list of companies.' 'Our business is dependent on the prices of gold, copper, silver, lead and zinc, which fluctuate on a daily basis and are affected by numerous factors beyond our control.' 'A substantial or extended decline in gold, copper, silver, lead or zinc prices would have a material adverse effect on us.' 'The metals markets are cyclical' (the FY2024 10-K's own words; it calls the metals markets it sells into cyclical, so CYCLICAL, the CB rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a gold miner on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names a miner), so the watch list is empty; Newmont holds no oil, gas or coal reserves and no refining, so ENERGY_TRANSITION is read as out of scope, and the 10-K's own climate words are a cost, not a stranded reserve: 'Policy and regulatory risk related to actual and proposed changes in climate- and water-related laws, regulations and taxes developed to regulate the transition to a low-carbon economy may result in increased costs for our operations, venture partners and our suppliers, including increased energy, capital equipment, environmental monitoring and reporting and other costs to comply with such regulations.' (the FY2024 10-K's risk factor) (text only); Newmont is no payments network, bank, exchange or remitter, so CRYPTO is read as out of scope, and the 10-K's own crypto words name an alternative to gold as an investment, a factor in the gold price: 'Changing investor or consumer sentiment, including in connection with transition to a low-carbon economy, investor interest in crypto currencies and other investment alternatives' (the FY2024 10-K's list of factors that move the gold price) (text only); Newmont sells metal, not software seats, services hours or content, so GENAI is read as out of scope, and the 10-K's own AI words are an operating tool and a cybersecurity risk: 'the adoption of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and cloud-based platforms' (the FY2024 10-K's cybersecurity risk words) (text only)

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY20-FY24 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.0%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.4-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY18 ex-FY19 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.0%/yr (FY20-FY24 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.0%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY20-FY24 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NEM (retrospective, 2025-06-06) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.82x (30.1% downside to Bear $36.61 / +36.8% upside to Bull $71.61) | Adj composite 2.79 vs market 2.90: gap -0.11 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +66% above the EPP floor $31.46 (11x FY25E $2.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +17.5% total (+8.8%/yr) | At 18.3x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $69.25 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +24.5% YoY in Q1 2025, forward revenues +24.5% (Q1 2025 revenue growth (no revenue guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
